source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Then, have the disposal company bring the office records back.
3. Update the record and label with a giant warning.
4. Have someone with outside expertise look over the work.
5. Send an action plan to the safety agency.
6. And when that fails, submit a Freedom of Information Act request to the state agency that has the inspection records.

The results will be yours. And everyone involved will think very hard if you ever consider suing them.

[Image source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Traffic_sign_-_Warning_-_Roadworks.svg)
